summary: Host-agent review of 52:39-58:27 (chapter "Building a Basic Calculator"). The transcript was read and all 9 screenshots were viewed. In PyCharm Community Edition (52:56) the presenter writes a script that reads two values with input(), adds them and prints the result (54:14). The first run with 5 and 8.3 prints 58.3 (54:40), because input() returns strings and + concatenates them (54:53). Wrapping both values in int() fixes whole numbers (56:15), but entering 4.3 and 5.5 raises ValueError: invalid literal for int() (56:57). Switching to float() (57:25) makes 4 + 5.5 print 9.5 (57:38). The exact Python version is not readable on screen: the interpreter path is cut off at "Python.framework/Versi".
